title: Recordings of cervical vagus nerve activity
author: Vitaly Napadow
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yxhfxj6

steps.title: Prepare Animal Subjects
steps.instruction: Anesthetize male and female Wistar rats (10-12 weeks old, weighing 232-400g).

steps.title: Set Up CVNA Recording
steps.instruction: Record cervical vagus nerve activity (CVNA) from the right and/or left cervical vagus nerve using hook electrodes.

steps.title: Configure Stimulation Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up a Grass S48 stimulator with a Grass stimulus isolation unit and constant current unit stimulator to deliver stimulation to the cymba and cavum conchae.

steps.title: Perform ABVN Stimulation
steps.instruction: Apply auricular branch of the vagus nerve (ABVN) stimulation according to the specified pulse trains and intensities.

substeps.instruction: Deliver a series of 5 stimulus pulse trains, each consisting of 0.5 mA current intensity, 0.5 ms pulse width, delivered at a frequency of 20Hz.
